blocks.text: NEARING ZERO HOUR— “‘According to the Scripts and the Scriptures scores of events will culminate simultaneously as the age ends! — As the prophet said, the end thereof shall be with a flood!’’? — ““Accordingly, the Scripts reveal a sudden surge of political, financial, social, scientific and religious changes will take place dramatic and powerful! — Also in a moment we will speak on the structural changes in the world building empires!’’ — ‘‘Israel is God’s prophetic clock, it tells us by its signs that time is short! — Since being in its homeland Israel has had wars and rumors of wars; and will have some more challenges yet! . . . But soon they will make an agreement (covenant) with a false friend! — This leader is alive now . . . peaceful,

but very deceptive!’’ — Dan. 11:21, ‘‘states the shadow of his coming . ..and in vrs. 39-45 shows the height of his power and his meteoric fall!’ — Verse 23, ‘‘it seems his rise will be out of a small kingdom

. . . but like magic itself is able to take over the world! — He is hidden now, but soon will be revealed! — He will control all false religions, the Vatican and the apostate Protestants, and chief prince of the Jews, sitting in the Temple . . . a false god!’’ (Dan. 9:26-27) — ‘‘Although still submerged, his presence is felt in many of the events that are occuring today!”’

POLITICAL CONNECTION— ‘‘Although he rises up from a small nation of people, Rev. 17:12-13 reveals suddenly 10 nations will back him, and will grow in power and authority and will be a dictator over all races, languages and nations! — He definitely is rising up out of the old revived Roman Empire! — Controlling the east and the west with his iron fists; and the prophet was perfectly right!’’ (Dan. 2:41-42) PROPHETIC NEWS — ‘“‘Since we gave this before there has been many heavenly signs telling us we are definitely in the latter times!’’ — “Years ago (AP) released a statement concerning an ancient forecaster and events supposedly leading up to the ending of the world before or by the ending of the 90’s! . . . Wherein at our time a Pope would rule for 15 years. This occured in Pope Paul VI! — And then a Pope would rule for less than 2 months! — We saw this occur! — Then it would be followed by the last two Popes! — One of these is in office now . . . and the reason for writing this is, I feel he will leave the scene . . . and according to the ancient prediction, one more is to arise! — And supposedly is to be in the days of the anti-christ, wherein the under world of the pagans will be in full swing again!’’ — ‘‘But first peace will be their disguiser before doom! — Be cautious and watch, many striking and electrifying events are ready to take place in the near future!’’

THE CITY OF LIGHTS— ‘‘We can predict a coming world ruler will be associated to a great city; a new electronic city joined to ‘world wide’ commercial Babylon and religious Babylon! — Finally the false prophet could actually give commands out of one of these cities!’’ — “‘As one of the greater cities of Babylon, let’s take a look at New York! . . . Years ago in one of my future predictions it said great structural changes would be occuring in the United States and different parts of the world! — And that new cities would be built, along with new designs! . . . Buildings and etc.! — This is beginning to occur in different places!’’ — “‘It has been reported a real estate developer and builder is planning to build a new city along the coastline of New York, costing billions! . . . A television-like city evidently world-wide satellite programs and much television produced there! . . . An electronic computer metropolis of the future! — Remember the false prophet operates out of a huge city commanding image worship! — Also they plan to build the world’s tallest building there! — Actually when they are finished it will probably change the skyline of that section! — New York itself has been called the Babylon-on-the-Hudson because of its great complexes! . . . And now with this new addition aptly so!’’ — “Let us see what is in New York! — It is known as a world-wide trade center, the United Nations is in New York City, also some apostate church headquarters is there, the Statue of Liberty — the symbol of the United States of America — is located there, the largest Jewish population lives there, international financers are located there, plus the gold reserves of other nations is stored there protected by the United States!’’ — ‘‘The world dictator will be closely associated to this city! For one thing he will be a commercial wizard and a clever politician and a religious deceiver!’’

GREAT BABYLON— of old will live again in the latter times! — Rev. chap. 17 reveals a great religious city, sitting on 7 hills! — This is none other than Rome wherein the Vatican has ruled over much of the earth! — It has been called the eternal city, but God calls it something else! — Mystery Babylon the great, the mother of the harlots, etc. — Its beginnings came forth from Babel, Egypt and Babylon on the Euphrates! — And her harlots represent the isms, cults and apostate Protestantism throughout the land! — And shall return unto her in the last few years of the age!’’ — ‘‘Behold, she will even sit upon and ride the beast powers! — But the beast ruler of commercial Babylon will tum upon Rome and the Vatican and will destroy it by fire, evidently
atomic desolation!’’ (Rev. 17:12-17) — ‘‘Now in our day Rome has never been known as a great commercial city, but only as a great religious city ruling over the earth! . . . And Rev. chap. 18 shows

us a great commercial city of the anti-christ and cities in world trade!”’ — ‘‘He will have undisputed control over the world’s finances and global control of business! — At his hand will be the greatest commercial city ever seen! — What will be inside this city and others like ier”?

CONTINUING GREAT BABYLON— ‘“‘It will all be like a fantasy world! — It’s merchandise will be of precious stone, pearls, beautiful silks, scarlets, etc. — It’s society will be clothed with the most costly jewels, the finest of perfumes! — They will have the finest of electronic controlled vehicles and the finest of air ships! — Trading will be at an all time high! — In this great city they will have their slaves, maids and etc. — Verses 12-13 reveals the richness of her goods! — We can not list all that will take place in this city where there is so much going on!’’ — “The city life will be incredible debauchery! — Promoters will be scheming how to make fast money . . . pleasure seekers will plan new ways of more pleasure! — The city of stud whores (read below) and sadistic bitches (whips) and herculen prostitutes (body building type) in similarity that Jesus referred to in Gen. 6, will reign there associated to a world-wide consortium of perverted orgies! — The finest of male harlots will be used to the ultimate in the sins of Sodom (verse 13)!’ — ‘Already in Paris there are ‘female men’ that can either sell themselves to man or woman; they are endowed for pleasure both ways! — Although mostly in appearance they dress and look like a female!’’ — “The city by night will be bright in its electric illumination! — The blood will run like fire in their veins, money will be their god, pleasure their high-priest and unbridled passion the ritual of their worship! — It will be a city of theaters, movies and sin houses where any kind of perversion can be bought if the right money is put up!’’ — ‘‘This is only a small spectrum of what will occur as the age closes out!’’ CONTINUING GREAT BABYLON — “‘In commercial Babylon satan will possess the mind and bodies of men! — Rev. 18, verse2... at that time Babylon will be the habitation of devils, the hold of every foul spirit and the cage of every unclean and hateful bird! — As one ancient well-known writer said, Quote: The city will be the seat of the most imposing ‘OCCULTISM”’ and mediums, and those desiring to communicate with the other world, will then go to Babylon, as men and women now go to Paris for fashions and sensuous pleasures! — In that day demons, disembodied souls and witchcraft spirits will find at Babylon the opportunity of their lives to materialize themselves in human bodies, and from the atmospheric heavens above, and from the Abyss below they will come in countless legions until Babylon shall be full of demon-possessed men and women! . . . And at the height of its glory, and just before its fall, Babylon will be ruled by SATAN HIMSELF, incarnate in the ‘Beast’-ANTI-CHRIST!’’ — ‘‘All the above will be easy to do as it is ruled by the prince of darkness, the god of this world will charm them into the most delusive pleasures ever seen! — Also the use of opiums, sorcery and drugs will be used in this coming fantasy world of doom!’’ — ‘‘One of the greater cities of Babylon we see will be located on a huge sea harbor! (Rev. 18:17) — But the Russians will destroy it with atomic power in one hour by electronic warfare!’’ (Verse 19 also Verses 8-10) — ‘‘Unless ancient Babylon is built in a very quick time we know that New York is the best candidate for one of the greater cities of the anti-christ! — It is already a city of luxury items and of world trade, and it does sit on a great harbor of waters!’”

THE FUTURE— “‘As we said before, there will be great structural changes in the United States and also a restructuring of the earth is beginning! — Despite economic recessions, depression, etc. . . . it will continue!’’ — ‘‘I predict in the next eight years that one will hardly know this planet that we live on! — This is because of what I have seen including the fantasy world of delusion just ahead! . . . And in science concerning the progress of what men are going to do and put in the hands of the anti-christ would be just simply unbelievable to many! — But yet, without hesitation it will surely come to pass in our near future!’’ — ‘‘During this time apostasy will sweep the earth! — But at the same time a mighty outpouring will come upon the children of the Lord! — It is our hour to work and shine for the Lord Jesus! — For us it is the hour of rejoicing for He is even at the door! — His
